title: Lincoln's Niagara speech on the giants whose bones fill the mounds

tellings.quote: Abraham Lincoln who's waxing poetically about Niagara Falls in a speech in which he says, "The eyes of that ancient species of giants whose bones fill the mounds of America have gazed upon Niagara as ours do."

plain: Abraham Lincoln, the American president, is said to have written a speech praising Niagara Falls in which he spoke of an ancient race of giants. A researcher named Tim Alberino quotes it from memory without naming where he found it: "The eyes of that ancient species of giants whose bones fill the mounds of America have gazed upon Niagara as ours do." Alberino brings it up because, if Lincoln wrote it, it would show that talk of giant bones in America's ancient earth mounds was taken seriously in his time.
